independent_formula: E lower bound=(max(0,n-34)+max(0,n+2-34))/2; all-success upper bound=(1[n<=34]+1[n+2<=34])/2
semantic_basis: Stock is decremented on release; initial canonical objects and replacement births are demand identities, not free material. Delivery adds four blanks per recipe to initial30; calibration lease adds no blanks. Matched BOM consumes each component once.
